verdict: REJECTED - fails every pre-committed criterion. TRAIN PF 0.912 (already below the 1.2 bar); TEST PF 0.546, materially worse out-of-sample, not just a marginal miss. Both directions (long and short) lose money in both periods; both instruments lose money combined (EUR_USD net -$385.62, GBP_USD net -$983.00); TRAIN win rate/PF is stable across 2020-2022 (0.907-0.921) but stably BELOW the bar, not above it - and further deteriorates in the single TEST year (2023, PF 0.546). The strategy's own drawdown-suspension safety limit fired 464 times in TRAIN and 363 times in TEST, an independent signal of how badly the strategy was losing, not just narrowly missing a P&L threshold. The 'momentum transfer' continuation hypothesis does not hold: confirmed Asian-range breakouts do not extend reliably enough to overcome even a 1:1 R:R structure, in this project's data, on any instrument, direction, or year tested.
closes_out: All three structurally distinct ways of trading the Asian/London range boundary tried in this project - reversal (V1, REJECTED), trend-filtered reversal (V2, REJECTED), and continuation (this candidate, REJECTED) - are now concluded.
